items.claim: [r39-6] canvas barrel says it withholds the content-handler list that the main entry exposes
items.note: (no longer applies). Commit 11f5c61976 rewrote the ingestion comment at `packages/core/src/barrel/canvas.ts:149`. The comment no longer calls anything withheld. It now says `contentHandlerRegistry` lists the handlers and that `runIngest`, `handlersFor`, and `couldClaim` come onto this entry from `editingSeams`, which is what `packages/core/src/index.ts:40` exports.

items.claim: `SceneMembershipError` thrown by scene calls but exported from no entry
items.note: It is now exported from `core/scene/index.ts` and the scene barrel, and sets its `name`. A new test in `index.barrel.test.ts` checks that every error class core declares is on the main entry. Before the fix it failed naming only this class. Changeset `scene-membership-error-export.md`.

A was wrong that the function doesn't exist: it does, in `domains/ingestion/contentHandlers.ts:160`, and it just isn't on the entry. Still, the comment was wrong. `contentHandlerRegistry` lists the same handlers, and `editingSeams` puts `runIngest`, `handlersFor` and `couldClaim` on the same entry, because `@weasel-js/editing` imports them. I kept those exports and rewrote the comment to say what the entry exposes. No test or changeset, since it's a comment only.
